title: Sprint Lighthouse — Console Standup Notes (UI / Rollouts / Analytics)
content:
Meeting: Sprint Lighthouse — Weekly console & tooling standup
Date: 2027-11-22 10:00–10:30 PT (30m)
Location: Zoom / #console-ops channel
Facilitator: Ava Martinez
Attendees: Ava M., Ethan C., Priya K., Noah P., Lina A., SRE on-call (Jon), Product (Maya)

Agenda:
1) Quick sync: UI feature progress
2) Rollout health & canary checks
3) Analytics ingestion and dashboard gaps
4) Blockers and triage
5) Action items for next week

Notes:
1) UI (Panel / Feature gating)
- Ethan: Panel v3 header refactor is in QA (PR #987). Manual smoke tests passed for Chrome/Firefox; Safari flaky on narrow width. QA ticket created: RT-1488.
- UX change: compact breadcrumb requested by product for multi-route flows. Design spec link added to the PR. Decision: ship header refactor behind feature flag (panel-header-v3) and enable for 10% of traffic initially.
- Accessibility: Priya found a missing aria-label on the rollout filter dropdown. Quick fix deployed to branch; patch to go out in hotfix if rollout is urgent.

2) Rollouts & Canary
- Noah: Canary group A showed elevated error-rate on long-polling websocket route between 03:00–03:20 PT yesterday; spike correlated with one node in us-west-2 hitting a kernel-level OOM (SRE investigating). Automatic fallback to regional edge succeeded, no customer-impact alarms triggered.
- Ticket RT-1423 tracks canary fallback improvement; proposed mitigation: add node-level backpressure to websocket handler (E2) and increase canary size temporarily to 15% during blue/green window to catch stateful regressions earlier.
- Decision: hold broad rollout until backpressure patch lands. Enable feature flag for internal/prod-admin only.

3) Analytics / Telemetry
- Lina: Ingestion lag on the per-route metrics pipeline increased to ~7m during a spike; root cause: batch window misconfiguration after recent pipeline refactor. Hotfix merged; roll forward scheduled tonight to reduce window from 90s -> 30s.
- Missing metric: lat50 for panel render is not present on the new analytics dashboard. Action: Lina to add derived metric and validate with synthetic traffic.
- Data retention: product asked for 90-day retention for rollout-trace events for auditability; cost estimate being drafted by SRE/infra.

4) Blockers / Risks
- Blocker: Kernel OOM root cause unknown (SRE). Until confirmed, we should avoid increasing canary/traffic to websocket-heavy variants.
- Risk: Safari layout flake could cause poor UX for a subset of enterprise customers. Prioritization requested from product.
- Operational risk: current CI job for end-to-end rollout rehearsals flakes intermittently (timeout). Release engineering to investigate and increase timeout and improve retry logic (owner: Priya).

5) Action Items (owners and ETA)
- Ethan: Merge header refactor behind feature flag; coordinate with QA to enable 10% canary by 2027-11-25. (ETA: 2027-11-25)
- Priya: Fix CI e2e timeout and add retry wrapper; open PR and link to RT-1501. (ETA: 2027-11-24)
- Noah + SRE (Jon): Root cause analysis for kernel OOM and proposal for node-level backpressure; publish RCA draft. (ETA: 2027-11-26)
- Lina: Add lat50 panel render metric to dashboard and validate with synthetic job; confirm ingestion window change after tonight's deployment. (ETA: 2027-11-23)
- Maya (Product): Decide on prioritization for Safari flake and confirm if it meets bar for broad rollout. (ETA: 2027-11-24)

Decisions logged:
- Ship header refactor behind feature flag -> 10% internal canary first.
- Defer broad websocket-heavy canary expansion until node backpressure patch deployed.

Follow-ups / next meeting:
- Quick sync on OOM RCA on 2027-11-24 09:00 PT (15m).
- Full standup next week: 2027-11-29 10:00 PT.

Notes to self / quick scratchpad (informal):
- remember to update rollout-runbook with canary fallback example and add snippet for manual reroute.
- check with infra billing about 90-day retention cost estimate (cc: finance).
- confirm if synthetic traffic job should run at 2am or 3am (Lina prefers 3am to avoid metric collision).

Relevant links and tickets:
- RT-1423: canary fallback improvement
- RT-1488: panel header QA
- RT-1501: e2e timeout rework
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/987
- Confluence: Console rollout guidelines (internal)

End of notes.
